summary: Golub Capital Private Credit Fund filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing monthly distributions and portfolio commentary. It confirmed previously declared September regular distributions of $0.1875 per Class I share and $0.1875 gross ($0.1703 net after a $0.0172 servicing/distribution fee) per Class S share, payable to holders of record September 30, 2026, with payment around October 30, 2026, in cash or via reinvestment. The filing also reported August 31, 2026 portfolio fair value of about $9,538 million across 454 companies, roughly $4,345 million NAV, debt-to-equity leverage of 1.24x, and per-share NAV of $24.28. No special-situation event, deal terms, or board recommendation is present.
